newsitem.title: GERMANY: Kinkel tells France of concerns over truck strike.
newsitem.headline: Kinkel tells France of concerns over truck strike.

text.p: German Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel told France's Herve de Charette on Friday that a 12-day-old French truck drivers' strike was harming small German companies and could kill some transport firms.
Kinkel wrote to the French foreign minister askinf for help to get German drivers out of blockades, a Foreign Ministry statement said.

French truck drivers have blockaded 230 main roads and almost half the country's petrol depots in a strike over pensions, pay and working hours. But unions signed an early retirement deal on Friday and said they would consult members whether to continue.
German Transport Minister Matthias Wissmann also pressed the French ambassador in Bonn to take action to relieve the unreasonable conditions for the German drivers in France.
